300 W. 15th Street
Austin, Texas 78701

Re:    SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349; PUC Docket No. 59475; Joint Application of Oncor Electric
       Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Services Corporation to Amend Their
       Certificates of Convenience and Necessity for the Bell County East Switch to Big Hill Substation
       765-kV Transmission Line Project in Bell, Burnet, Concho Coryell, Lampasas, Llano, Mason,
       McCulloch, Menard, Milam, Mills, San Saba, Schleicher, Tom Green, and Williamson Counties;
       Replies to Exceptions to Proposal for Decision

Dear Judges Brite, Burgess, and Marlo Chico:

         Larry and Donna Martin (the Martins) have reviewed the State Office of Administrative Hearings’
Proposal for Decision (PFD) filed on August 20, 2026, and submits this letter to note their support for the PFD’s
finding that the Applicants have not established that the amendment of Applicants’ certificates of convenience
and necessity is necessary for the service, accommodation, convenience, or safety of the public. 1 If the
Application is not denied, the Martins respectfully requests that a route not utilizing Link J24 be approved. 2

       Should you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact my office.


Best wishes,

/s/ Rashmin Asher

Rashmin Asher
Attorney for Larry and Donna Martin




       1   SOAH PFD with Memorandum at 162 (Aug. 20, 2026).
       2   Initial Brief of Larry and Donna Martin’s Link J24, Parcel Number 1350 at 6 (Jun. 19, 2026).
